name: pintag-rental-pricing-tests
description: End-to-end coverage for the three rental-pricing additions: a Daily rate tier, per-unit-type lease-term pricing (Daily/Monthly/3/6/12) for apartments and condos, and the Trash Fee rental term (Included | Amount, monthly).
